//: The ' ?.ts' patterns exclude iCloud's duplicate files. This project lives under ~/Documents, which iCloud syncs, and it duplicates generated files inside .next/types as 'routes.d 2.ts' and the like while the build is writing them. Those duplicates fail typecheck with 'Duplicate identifier', which looks like a real break and is not. Note the glob: TypeScript supports only *, ? and **/ — it does NOT support [0-9] character classes, so the earlier '**/* [0-9].ts' matched nothing and this was never actually excluded. Verified by running tsc with the duplicates present.
